# @karni/ui

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/generate-ui-doc.mjs` in packages/karni-ui; never edit by hand. -->

Everything the package exports from its root (`import { ... } from "@karni/ui"`),
from the manifest built with the package (`@karni/ui/manifest.json`, which
coding agents read too). Props and usage are in the
[package README](https://github.com/cbsshekhawat18-lab/karni/blob/main/packages/karni-ui/README.md);
the resource components render from the backend's OpenAPI schema, so a page
is a few lines composing them (see the [tutorial](tutorial.md)).

## Resource components (schema-driven)

- `ResourceTable` — role `data-table`
- `ResourceForm` — role `resource-form`
- `ResourceDetail` — role `detail-view`
- `ResourceSelect` — role `async-select`
- `ChangeHistory` — role `change-history`
- `ResourceImport` — role `resource-import`

## App shell and pages

- `Layout` — role `layout-shell`
- `Page` — role `page-shell`
- `EmptyState` — role `empty-state`
- `Modal` — role `modal`
- `ModalClose`
- `Toaster` — role `toast`
- `Stat` — role `stat`
- `DataChart` — role `chart`
- `FileUpload` — role `file-upload`
- `KarniMark`

## Auth

- `AuthProvider`
- `AuthGuard` — role `auth-guard`
- `LoginForm` — role `login-form`
- `KarniProvider`

## Primitives

Styled Radix parts and basics; `className` always merges, refs are forwarded.

`Button`, `Checkbox`, `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuGroup`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuLabel`, `DropdownMenuPortal`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `Input`, `Label`, `Select`, `SelectContent`, `SelectGroup`, `SelectItem`, `SelectLabel`, `SelectRoot`, `SelectSeparator`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`, `Skeleton`, `Switch`, `Tabs`, `TabsContent`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger`, `Textarea`

## Hooks

- `useAuth` — `{ user, status, login(email, password), logout, refresh }` from `AuthProvider`.
- `useChangeHistory` — One row's field-level change history (`GET /<resource>/<id>/history/`, audited models).
- `useImportActions` — `upload`, `preview` (the dry run) and `commit` mutations of an import.
- `useImportDescribe` — The importable fields of a resource and the user's remembered column mapping.
- `useImportJob` — One import job's state; polls while the backend previews or commits it.
- `useKarniClient` — The `KarniClient` behind every hook: `client.request(path, { method, body, query })` for custom actions.
- `usePermission` — `{ hasRole(...names), isAuthenticated }` for gating UI on roles.
- `useResourceItem` — One row by id, optionally expanded.
- `useResourceList` — A page of a resource: `{ page, pageSize, ordering, search, filters, expand }` → DRF's `{ count, next, previous, results }`.
- `useResourceMutations` — `create`, `update`, `remove` for a resource; they invalidate the resource's queries on success.
- `useSchema` — The parsed OpenAPI schema of one resource (fields, operations, access).
- `useToast` — Show a toast through the mounted `Toaster`.

## Component roles

Every top-level component claims one semantic role; `karni make component` refuses a
role another component holds (compose it instead), and `karni context` lists them.

| Role | Component |
|---|---|
| `async-select` | `ResourceSelect` |
| `auth-guard` | `AuthGuard` |
| `change-history` | `ChangeHistory` |
| `chart` | `DataChart` |
| `data-table` | `ResourceTable` |
| `detail-view` | `ResourceDetail` |
| `empty-state` | `EmptyState` |
| `file-upload` | `FileUpload` |
| `layout-shell` | `Layout` |
| `login-form` | `LoginForm` |
| `modal` | `Modal` |
| `page-shell` | `Page` |
| `resource-form` | `ResourceForm` |
| `resource-import` | `ResourceImport` |
| `stat` | `Stat` |
| `toast` | `Toaster` |
